dishes.name: Raclette du Valais
dishes.desc: Cheese melted from the wheel and scraped over potatoes, pickles and dried meat. Valais cheese carries a protected designation and the dish is from here.

dishes.name: Cholera
dishes.desc: Baked vegetable pie with leeks, potatoes, apples and cheese. The Valais dish got its name from an old cholera outbreak and is found in local restaurants.

dishes.name: Valais dried meat
dishes.desc: Air-dried beef, cured ham and dried bacon with protected status. Valais plates serve it with rye bread and pickles.

dishes.name: Walliser Roggenbrot
dishes.desc: Dense sourdough rye bread with a protected designation, baked in the Valais. It is eaten with cheese and dried meat.

dishes.name: Gsottus
dishes.desc: Hearty soup of dried meat, with the broth poured over rye bread and cheese. A traditional Valais mountain dish.
